newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC reports bids for 217,000 wheat at nil value.
newsitem.headline: ONIC reports bids for 217,000 wheat at nil value.

text.p: European grain firms bidding through France placed bids to export 217,000 tonnes of soft wheat under licences carrying a nil value refund and 214,500 tonnes of flour under licences carrying a five Ecus per tonne rebate, France's grain office ONIC said on Tuesday.
Exporters placed the bids on Tuesday, ONIC specified. The European Commission has three days to decide whether to accept or reject the bids.
On Monday the EU scrapped a zero refund for soft wheat and durum wheat exports, replacing it with a nil value refund amid soaring world wheat market prices.
The nil value refund cannot be prefixed and has no monthly increments.

European grain industry sources said earlier they were waiting to see whether the European Commission would reduce its standing refund for wheat flour exports from its current level of five Ecus per tonne in the wake of Monday's abolition of the zero refund for wheat grain exports.
